title: add-ci-artifact-signing-provenance-release-manifests-private-installer
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: ensure all Private Installer release artifacts are reproducibly built, signed, and distributed with provenance metadata so downstream enterprise customers can verify integrity. This PR adds CI steps to build and sign installer artifacts with cosign, generate SBOMs with Syft, and emit release manifests (release-manifests.yaml + provenance metadata) used by our release automation. Includes minimal Helm value updates so the installer references signed images and public provenance URLs.

What this PR does: - Adds CI job `build:installer` that produces tarball + container images and records sha256 checksums; - Adds `sign:cosign` job that signs artifacts and uploads signatures to the release bucket; - Generates Syft SBOMs for the installer tarball and images and attaches them to the provenance manifest; - Emits `release/manifests/private-installer/{{version}}` which includes artifact URLs, checksums, cosign signatures and SBOM references; - Updates `charts/private-installer/values.yaml` to include `imageProvenance: true` and pointer to manifest URL template; - Adds basic KMS integration docs (GCP KMS / AWS KMS) and a CI flag to toggle cloud KMS vs ephemeral cosign key for CI.

Checklist: - [x] CI build and sign steps added and tested in ephemeral pipeline - [x] SBOM generation for tarball & images - [x] Release manifest format documented and validated against downstream release automation - [x] Helm chart values updated for provenance-aware installer - [x] Integration tests (smoke) passing in CI - [x] Release notes prepared

Related: Linear ENG-2345, ENG-2489. See design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2345/provenance-and-signing-for-private-installer (internal).
change_summary: Adds cosign signing + syft SBOM generation to CI, produces release manifests with artifact URLs/checksums/signatures, updates Helm values to reference signed artifact provenance, docs and upgrade notes for operators.
commits: feat(ci): add installer build job producing tarball and container images
feat(ci): integrate cosign signing step and upload signatures to release bucket
chore(release): emit release manifests with checksums, signatures, and SBOM links
fix(chart): update private-installer values for imageProvenance and manifest templates
docs: add KMS notes and verification steps to release docs
review_comments: Liam Chen: Can we wire cosign key retrieval to KMS rather than embedding keys in CI? Suggest a feature flag to toggle KMS-backed signing.
Asha Patel: Added KMS integration notes and CI flag `COSIGN_USE_KMS=true`. For ephemeral CI keys we still sign artifacts in ephemeral mode but manifest will indicate unsigned-by-KMS.
Marta Ruiz: Please ensure SBOM includes image layers and package versions; confirm syft config produces SPDX document.
Asha Patel: Syft now produces SPDX+CycloneDX (config in scripts/generate-sbom.sh) and artifacts are attached to the manifest.
release_notes: - CI: add artifact signing with cosign and SBOM generation with Syft; - Release: emit release manifests containing artifact URLs, checksums, cosign signatures and SBOM references; - Charts: private-installer gain provenance-aware values (imageProvenance).
upgrade_instructions: Operators: release manifests are produced at release time under release/manifests/private-installer/<version>. Use `redwood-installer verify --manifest <url>` to validate signatures and SBOMs before upgrade. If KMS-backed signing is configured, set COSIGN_KMS_URI in installer config. See docs/private-installer/provenance.md for full steps.
notes_for_release_automation: Release automation consumes manifest-template.yaml and will publish signed artifacts to the official bucket. The manifest includes fields: name, version, artifacts[{url, sha256, cosign_sig_url, sbom_url}]. Ensure the release job has access to COSIGN_KMS_URI when KMS mode is enabled.
security_considerations: CI stores ephemeral signing keys by default; for production releases we require KMS-backed cosign keys. Access controls added to release bucket and signatures are published alongside SBOMs. Ensure audit logs are enabled for KMS key usage.
